notes: TMax-15K is an almost perfect pool for this task: it contains a large, explicit 'reverse-engineer a stripped binary and write a bit-exact C/C++ replacement, verified by fuzzing against the oracle, do not invoke or hardcode' cluster (task_000764/000007/000049/004392/000865/000140/000089/000174 and more) - these match all three axes including task_form, so the honest top 8 are all TMax and score 4-5. I favored the ones whose deliverable is C and whose verification is bit-exact fuzzing, exactly mirroring the 'gcc -static ... && ./reversed identical to ./mystery' contract. The only axis nothing in the pool teaches is the gzip<2k source-size budget (no code-golf/minimal-program tasks exist), same gap as the path-tracing sibling. Non-TMax corpora offer binary-RE-adjacent work only: TW and RTS have crackme reverse-engineering (strong on skill/domain, but the deliverable is a recovered password, not a reimplementation), and SWE-Smith/Rebench offer decoder/interpreter bug fixes (pfp binary-template interpreter, pdfminer codecs, jinja bytecode) that exercise reproducing an opaque format's exact semantics. Merge note: this task and path-tracing overlap heavily in TMax picks (the bit-exact-reference cluster) - task_000089, task_000140, task_000033 appear in both - which is correct, since 'reverse a generator and reimplement to match' is the shared crux; path-tracing-reverse simply weights the binary/stripped-ELF domain higher and rewards C-output + fuzz-verified equivalence more.
